name: dp-it-normativa-convert
description: Converts the Normattiva export zip of an act into a load plan: <stem>.plan.json (vigente units, SCD-2 history rows, act row), <stem>.akn.xml (latest version) and <stem>.convert.json. Python; writes the data directory only, no DB.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item read <dirIn>/<stem>.zip and write the plan files into dirOut. An act that cannot be converted is skipped and the run ends with system_error listing the failed keys.

items.description: the acts to convert, as reported by the detect step

collection.description: label stored on every unit (default NORMATTIVA)

output.description: { dirOut, converted: [{key, plan, akn, meta}], metrics: {acts, units, versions, versionRows} }
